title: Completeness of original Pixton relations on closed moduli
exact_target: For every stable (g,n), do the original Pixton dual-graph relations, together with their pullbacks and pushforwards, generate the entire kernel of the strata-algebra map to $R*(Mbar_{g,n})$? Only closed moduli are asserted; compact-type and rational-tail completeness are separate.
